description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

IBM is hiring an entry-level Cloud Developer to support its IBM Cloud platform. The role focuses on researching cloud technologies, building cloud-based prototypes, and implementing and supporting infrastructure, automation, security, and monitoring solutions.
Entry-Level Cloud Developer automating IBM Cloud infrastructure and building OpenShift/Kubernetes test pipelines, CI/CD, and service monitoring

Responsibilities:
• Implement and automate infrastructure solutions that support IBM Cloud products and infrastructure
• Build & Set up test automation and pipeline frameworks in OpenShift and/or Kubernetes environments
• Administer automated CI/CD systems and tools for development and test teams
• Support the compliance and security integrity of the environment
• Partner with other teams, managers and program managers to develop alerting and monitoring for mission-critical services
• Support development of new and enhance existing capabilities for our compute infrastructure services
• Provide technical escalation support for other Infrastructure Operations teams

Requirements:
• High School Diploma/GED
• Pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's Degree in: Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering or related majors
• Prior (project or internship) experience in development, computer hardware or testing
• Strong verbal and written communication skills
• Passion for technology and engineering
• Growth minded, trusted, team focused, courageous, resourceful, and outcome focused
• IBM will not be providing visa sponsorship for this position now or in the future. Therefore, in order to be considered for this position, you must have the ability to work without a need for current or future visa sponsorship

Preferred:
• Bachelor's Degree
• Proficiency in one or more of the following technology areas:
• Working knowledge with one or more operating systems:  Ubuntu (Preferred), RHEL, CentOS Linux, and Windows Servers
• Working knowledge with one or more Virtualization technologies: Citrix Hypervisor (Preferred), VMware vSphere, Ubuntu KVM, etc
• Working knowledge with one or more programming tools:  Java, Bash, PowerShell, Python, Ruby and Go
• Working knowledge with one or more key infrastructure tools/products:  Active Directory, Ansible, Chef, etc
• Working knowledge with Container technologies:  Kubernetes (preferred), Docker, etc
• Working knowledge with Monitoring technologies:   Zabbix (preferred), Splunk, etc
• Working knowledge with Network and Storage technologies
• Working knowledge with ServiceNow, JIRA, Confluence, and GitHub
